summary: Senior finance and banking professional with roughly two decades of experience spanning bank treasury, credit administration, and corporate finance management. Began in retail and treasury banking, managing a multi-billion-rupee investment portfolio and liquidity, CRR/SLR compliance, and trade finance including export/import bills and letters of credit. Subsequently served as Finance Manager leading accounts, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow analysis, MIS reporting, internal and annual audits, bank facility negotiations, and ERP-based financial data migration. Also experienced in community association financial administration, escrow and trust accounts, payroll and HR compliance, and regulatory compliance including KYC/AML.
